notifyNoticeText: {LMA_USER} is using Live Meeting Assistant to record and transcribe this meeting ({meeting}). If you do not agree, say so, and recording and transcription will stop.
optInNoticeText: {LMA_USER} would like to record and transcribe this meeting ({meeting}) with Live Meeting Assistant. Nothing is recorded or transcribed until everyone has agreed.
videoNoticeText: Video of the meeting, including shared screens and any visible camera feeds, is also recorded.
consentPhrases: I consent, I agree, I accept
objectionPhrases: I object, I do not consent, I don't consent, I do not agree, I don't agree, do not record, don't record, stop recording
advanceConsentText: I agree that {organizer} may record and transcribe {scope} with Live Meeting Assistant, including what I say, what I type in the meeting chat and, where the meeting's video is recorded, my camera feed and any screen I share. I can withdraw this consent at any time on the My consents page, and I can still object during any meeting.
